lead: Notes from home and abroad: essays on Philippine history and culture, with a dash of my own experience.
intro: I’m Lexi Zotomayor, a journalist who has spent years writing about islands, archives and the people who keep the past alive. Ditse is where I write about home: the Philippines, and the Filipinos who carry it with them abroad.
These are not textbooks. They are field notes: what I read, where I went, who I asked and what I still wonder about. Mga sanaysay sa kasaysayang may saysay: essays on a history that means something.

find.title: Ancient Roots
find.text: Balangay, baybayin, the terraces and the peoples who were here before the galleons.

find.title: Colonial Encounters
find.text: Three centuries of Spain, then America: faith, trade, revolt and the making of a nation.

find.title: War and Memory
find.text: Revolution, the Pacific War, and how families and towns remember them.

find.text: Balikbayan boxes, overseas work, and the Philippines we carry abroad.
